meta.title: WoW Forever Shaman spell ranks, every level 1-60

status_legend.forever: Forever client data (build 1.60.1.70862) as carried by wowsims-forever

source.records: sim/core/spelldata/spells_auto_gen.go (wowsims's generator bakes in tools/database/overrides; any override comment is copied to the rank's wowsims_overrides: those fields are wowsims's in-game measurements, not client rows)
source.vanilla: cmangos classic-db spell_template (1.12) for vanilla_* fields, npc_trainer_template 71 + npc_trainer rows of class 7 trainers for vanilla_trainer (teach spell -> learned spell through effect 36 LEARN_SPELL)

formulas.value_at_level: BasePoints + PPL * clamp(min(L, scaling_max_level) - scaling_base_level, 0); scaling_max_level 0 = no cap. Computed in float32 as wowsims Effect.AverageAt. Damage/heal amounts keep the fraction; every other amount is floored.
formulas.cost: cost.mana flat; cost.pct_base_mana = pct of base mana (base_mana table in <class>_levels.json); cost.rage in rage (row value / 10); cost.energy; cost.combo_points_min = the finisher needs at least that many; cost.health (Life Tap row has none: wowsims spends amount + Spirit).
formulas.learn_level: SpellLevels.SpellLevel of the rank (client). learned_from.vanilla_trainer gives the vanilla 1.12 trainer level and cost for comparison. 2 Nov notes: training every class ability 1-60 costs 206-207 gold in Forever, so vanilla costs are not Forever costs.
formulas.vanilla_compare: vanilla.changes_vs_vanilla compares learn level, flat cost, cooldowns and each effect's amount at the learn level (vanilla BasePoints+1 .. BasePoints+DieSides, Forever tooltip range) with the 1.12 row of the same id. A difference of 1 point or less is ignored. Cast times and durations are not compared (the 1.12 rows store index ids into tables not in the local data).
formulas.required_stance_mask: client StanceMask bit field (1 << (form id - 1)); e.g. warrior Battle 17, Defensive 18, Berserker 19; druid Cat 1, Bear 5, Dire Bear 8, Moonkin 31.

coefficient_penalties.finding: Neither wowsims-forever nor mythicsim-forever-engine applies the vanilla sub-20 penalty (1 - (20 - spellLevel)*0.0375) or a downrank coefficient penalty. Ranks learned below 20 carry sp_coef_if_vanilla_sub20_penalty so a sim can switch the vanilla rule on.
coefficient_penalties.forever_notes: kami-labs summary of the 2 Nov 2026 notes: the low-rank penalty was removed from several chance-based talents and stays on Arcane Concentration, Frostbite and Fingers of Frost (proc less often when the rank was learned more than 12 levels below the caster). Nothing in the notes speaks to damage/heal coefficients of low ranks.

forever_class_notes: See data/shaman_ranks.json notes (copied into the families it covers) and the Mage & Shaman deep dive: totems 1.0 s GCD, persistent totems 5 min, weapon imbues 60 min, Windfury and Flametongue totems are party buffs, Fire Nova Totem replaced by the Fire Nova spell, Totemic Recall, Call of the Elements/Spirits/Ancestors. 2 Nov notes: Lightning Bolt max rank +80%, Chain Lightning 2.5 s, shocks back to Classic Era base damage, Stormstrike 150% / 6 s.
notes_sources: Warcraft Tavern summaries of Blizzard's Forever class deep dives: Priest & Warrior (1 Oct 2026, Blizzard news 24301514), Mage & Shaman (7 Oct, 24302097), Rogue & Warlock (7 Oct, 24310968); 'All Changes to Paladins' (21 Sep 2026); 'WoW Forever Pre-Launch Class Changes & Bug Fixes' (4 Nov 2026, from Kaivax's Beta Development Notes updated 2 Nov).
Blizzard news 'World of Warcraft: Forever Class Deep Dives - Hunter and Druid' (news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24301515).
kami-labs 'WoW Forever November 2 patch: 223 changes before launch' (datamined items marked).
The Blizzard forum dev-notes thread itself could not be fetched here (needs approval); its content is taken from the summaries above.
Where a note and a client row disagree, the row wins; the row values are the ones in ranks[].

wowsims_code_notes.comment: The cast, with the overload it may trigger; the overload itself, from its own row, where overload is nil. Both jump alike, so an overload reaches as many targets as the cast, starting on the target that triggered it. The effect states the targets the bolt reaches and what each jump keeps. Every hit is rolled before any lands, so a proc off the first target cannot raise the damage of the next. Each target the cast hits rolls its own overload, at a third of Lightning Bolt's chance. An overload rolls none of its own. DealDamage disposes the result, so Landed is read first. TODO: Ingame test needed: the tooltip of 408438 states one chance for both spells. The overloads are priced once every hit of the cast has landed, so a debuff charge one of those hits spends, such as Stormstrike's, does not also raise an overload that jumps there.

notes: 2.5 s cast, sp_coef 0.714, 6 s category cooldown, 3 targets, each jump 70% of the previous (chain_amp 0.7). Costs are the live 6 Nov 2026 values.

wowsims_code_notes.comment: Strength of Earth's rank 4 and Grace of Air's rank 2 are the last ranks the trainer teaches; the Tablet of Strength of Earth Totem V and Tablet of Grace of Air Totem III books teach the ranks above them. A totem's cast: the row's cost, GCD and cooldown, and nothing it hits. Stands a totem in its element's slot for the totem row's duration, taking down the one there. A totem the sim models as the buff it gives its caster, lasting as long as the totem stands. A weapon totem stands as an aura of the totem row's duration that holds the totem's category, which turns its proc on. The proc is core/buffs', shared with the raid buff of the same totem. The rows already carry Improved Weapon Totems: Windfury's attack power and Flametongue's damage are its 30% and 12% over their untalented values, so nothing applies the talent. Under a standing Windfury Totem, Flametongue Totem's proc does nothing. The rows already carry Enhancing Totems: Strength of Earth's and Grace of Air's amounts are its 15% over their untalented values, so nothing applies the talent. The aura reads Restorative Totems' first effect, the Mana Spring share, from the talent points. A fire totem, so it stands in the slot Fire Nova radiates from. Commented out upstream of this fork by "only 1 totem per type" (53970b1d84), not by the Forever stubbing pass, and never called since. It is kept rather than reduced to the usual empty-body no-op because the body is the only record of how the totem was modelled; shaman.HealingStreamTotem stays nil until someone revisits totem slots.

FlametongueWeapon.name: Flametongue Weapon

wowsims_code_notes.comment: Windfury Weapon and Flametongue Weapon put the same passive on the weapon at every rank, and the rank decides only which spells the passive fires, so they are read off the top rank's refs.

notes: Passive 436519 (ProcChance 100): every main-hand melee hit casts the Flametongue Attack.
Damage per hit (wowsims weapon_imbues.go newFlametongueImbueSpell) = proc.m1(L) * MH_swing_speed_s / 100 + attack.m1 (0), fire, sp_coef 0.1 (attack spell), can crit.
proc.m1(L) = the linked 'Flametongue Weapon Proc' spell's E_DUMMY value at level L (RefIDs[0]); attack spell = RefIDs[1] (29469, 29470, then 10444 for ranks 3-6).
Tooltip check: rank 6 at 60 is 2498+78*4=2810 -> 36.5 (1.3 s) to 112.4 (4.0 s) per hit.

LightningShield.name: Lightning Shield

wowsims_code_notes.comment: One shield is up at a time, so the shield proc rate option spends a charge of whichever it is. The shield proc rate option stands for the hits a shaman takes when nothing attacks it in the sim. The talent teaches Water Shield: three globes for 10 minutes, one of which a hit taken or one of the shaman's spell crits spends, at most once every 3.5 s, to restore 408511's 2% of maximum mana. The row hears both on one mask, but its tooltip asks for a crit only of the shaman's own spells ("when a spell, melee, or ranged attack hits the caster or when one of the caster's spells gets a critical result"), so the two are separate triggers sharing the globes and the cooldown. Answers what spends a globe for the shield proc rate option. The shield's effect 1 fires 26545, a dummy, and the orb its tooltip names deals the damage. 10432 holds three charges for 10 minutes, and a hit taken spends one, at most once every 3.5 s, to strike the attacker with the orb. The row cannot crit. The cooldown is the trigger's own, shared with the shield proc rate option.

notes: Forever rows: 3 charges, 10 min, ICD 3.5 s between orb discharges.

The shield's proc effect fires 26545 (a dummy, SPCoef 1); the damage spell is the rank's orb named in RefIDs[0] (wowsims shields.go reads Refs()[0]). Orb damage has no level scaling, sp_coef 0.267, cannot crit (wowsims).

WaterShield.talent_ladder_note: spelldata.Talent(id, 1): one spell whose effects scale with talent points; only the row is listed

wowsims_code_notes.comment: One shield is up at a time, so the shield proc rate option spends a charge of whichever it is. The shield proc rate option stands for the hits a shaman takes when nothing attacks it in the sim. The talent teaches Water Shield: three globes for 10 minutes, one of which a hit taken or one of the shaman's spell crits spends, at most once every 3.5 s, to restore 408511's 2% of maximum mana. The row hears both on one mask, but its tooltip asks for a crit only of the shaman's own spells ("when a spell, melee, or ranged attack hits the caster or when one of the caster's spells gets a critical result"), so the two are separate triggers sharing the globes and the cooldown. Answers what spends a globe for the shield proc rate option. The shield's effect 1 fires 26545, a dummy, and the orb its tooltip names deals the damage. 10432 holds three charges for 10 minutes, and a hit taken spends one, at most once every 3.5 s, to strike the attacker with the orb. The row cannot crit. The cooldown is the trigger's own, shared with the shield proc rate option.

notes: Restoration talent (tier 3, SpellLevel 20). One rank. No mana cost.

3 globes, 10 min. A hit taken, or one of the shaman's own spell crits (wowsims reading of the tooltip), spends a globe at most once per 3.5 s and restores 408511's 2% of MAXIMUM mana (E_ENERGIZE_PCT 2).
Mana per globe at level L = 0.02 * max_mana(L); no level term in the data.

wowsims_code_notes.comment: Strength of Earth's rank 4 and Grace of Air's rank 2 are the last ranks the trainer teaches; the Tablet of Strength of Earth Totem V and Tablet of Grace of Air Totem III books teach the ranks above them. A totem's cast: the row's cost, GCD and cooldown, and nothing it hits. Stands a totem in its element's slot for the totem row's duration, taking down the one there. A totem the sim models as the buff it gives its caster, lasting as long as the totem stands. A weapon totem stands as an aura of the totem row's duration that holds the totem's category, which turns its proc on. The proc is core/buffs', shared with the raid buff of the same totem. The rows already carry Improved Weapon Totems: Windfury's attack power and Flametongue's damage are its 30% and 12% over their untalented values, so nothing applies the talent. Under a standing Windfury Totem, Flametongue Totem's proc does nothing. The rows already carry Enhancing Totems: Strength of Earth's and Grace of Air's amounts are its 15% over their untalented values, so nothing applies the talent. The aura reads Restorative Totems' first effect, the Mana Spring share, from the talent points. A fire totem, so it stands in the slot Fire Nova radiates from. Commented out upstream of this fork by "only 1 totem per type" (53970b1d84), not by the Forever stubbing pass, and never called since. It is kept rather than reduced to the usual empty-body no-op because the body is the only record of how the totem was modelled; shaman.HealingStreamTotem stays nil until someone revisits totem slots.

WindfuryWeapon.name: Windfury Weapon

wowsims_code_notes.comment: Windfury Weapon and Flametongue Weapon put the same passive on the weapon at every rank, and the rank decides only which spells the passive fires, so they are read off the top rank's refs.

notes: Each rank's cast enchants the weapon (E_360, misc = SpellItemEnchantment id, 1800 = 30 min).
The proc roll is the shared passive 439431: 20% chance (ProcChance 20) on main-hand melee hits, ICD 1.5 s. wowsims uses this passive for every rank (weapon_imbues.go).

On proc the rank's triggered spell (RefIDs[0]) grants 2 extra attacks (E_ADD_EXTRA_ATTACKS 2) with +AP (A_MOD_ATTACK_POWER, scales per level up to max_level) for those attacks. Vanilla gave 1 extra attack.
